svg.title: The failure ladder
svg.desc: A ladder of twelve layers that can fail between you and your wealth, from your broker at the bottom to the market itself at the top, each with the backstop meant to protect you. Higher rungs affect more of your wealth at once.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe UI, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every layer between you and your wealth, and what's meant to catch you.
